method: Serial fresh processes, balanced order; 32768 operations per observation across 128 matching canonical ASCII HTTP(S) inputs. One discarded warm-up per case, three measured observations, one process median is the observation unit. Imports, correctness checks and forced GC are outside timing; GC during the operation loop is included. Results are consumed.
noiseRule: Four-million-operation CPU probes bracket each timed observation. Five warm-ups and nine calibrations fix a 1.5x median threshold before the suite. Reject the whole three-variant round for a case if any probe exceeds the threshold; require four qualifying rounds. No extra rounds or outcome-based exclusions.
limitation: Parser/serialization microbenchmark, not a crawler migration or comparison against all JavaScript URL libraries. No explicit heap-pressure workload. Inputs intentionally avoid known semantic differences; matching outputs do not establish equivalent behavior for arbitrary URLs.

references.quote: Node.js 20 includes specific changes, such as the updated version 2.0 of Ada, a fast and spec-compliant URL parser written in C++.
references.scope: Evidence for implementation and design; not a URIjs comparison. Runtime process.versions reports the Ada version recorded above.
